This method is described in the Splatshop paper [S1] as an optimization for the rendering pipeline that sorts splats by depth before creating fragments to reduce sorting costs [S1].

The claim states that the method sorts splats by depth before creating fragments to reduce sorting costs. The evidence explicitly confirms this: 'Sorting Splats by Depth. We sort the list of staged splats by their depth values... In the original 3DGS pipeline, sorting is done after the splats were split into fragments... The evidence also confirms that fragments are created after this sorting step ('Creating Tile Fragments. This stage creates one tile fragment item for each tile a splat touches. Since we already sorted splats by depth...'). Therefore, every fact in the claim is supported by the evidence.
